assertions.assertion: States that v4 uses HybridCache for token caching (not the old IDistributedCache directly)
assertions.rationale: Describes caching as built on IDistributedCache and never mentions HybridCache.

assertions.assertion: Explains the two-tier L1 (in-memory) + L2 (distributed) cache architecture
assertions.rationale: Presents in-memory and distributed as alternative single backends, not a two-tier L1+L2 architecture.

assertions.assertion: Notes that explicit AddDistributedMemoryCache() registration is no longer required in v4
assertions.rationale: Instead instructs the reader to register AddDistributedMemoryCache() for single-instance use, the opposite of the v4 behavior.

assertions.assertion: Mentions CacheLifetimeBuffer as a configuration option for controlling token refresh timing
assertions.rationale: Shows options.CacheLifetimeBuffer = 60 to control how early tokens refresh before expiry.
